results.title: Odeberecy
results.overview: In "ODEBERECY," we follow a day in the life of a babalorixá during a Candomblé festival, seen through the eyes of his spiritual children. Amidst rituals, displays of affection, responsibilities, and moments of celebration, the film reveals the human dimension behind the figure of the Pai de Santo, exploring the relationships forged within the terreiro and the bonds of ancestry, faith, and belonging that sustain this community.

results.title: The Cover Up
results.overview: The Church, long-proclaimed bastion of virtue, is now facing an historic reckoning as residential school survivors in Canada seek justice. With the discovery of 215 bodies at the former residential school site in Kamloops, BC in May 2021, a watershed moment in Canadian history exploded into the world's consciousness. First Nation, Inuit, and Metis survivors across the nation told police their stories of abuse, neglect, experimentation, and even murder for decades -but their truths were considered lies until physical evidence proved otherwise.

results.title: Where Are the Pigeons ?
results.overview: Victor, a passionate birdwatcher, is convinced that all the pigeons have vanished. When he meets Abby, a photographer, there’s no doubt for him : she is the mastermind behind their disappearance. What follows is a duel between Abby's budding love and Arthur's growing paranoia, where everything is held together by a feather.

results.title: Police Detective Parker
results.overview: Alton C. Parker became the first Black police officer in his hometown in 1941, later rising to become Canada’s first Black detective. In an era marked by deep racial bias, he broke barriers within the Windsor Police Force, confronting skepticism and systemic obstacles. Through skill, resilience, and determination, he earned the respect of colleagues and the community. His journey reshaped perceptions within law enforcement and helped spark broader social change, leaving a lasting legacy of possibility.

results.title: Delicatessen
results.overview: A dinner turns into a ritual of subjugation when a woman is forced to eat her meal. The consumption becomes an uncontrollable, monstrous impulse, revealing the face of guilt.

results.title: Five Minute Brides
results.overview: Twice a year, Skipton seamstress Mandy Abramson invites women of any age, shape or size into her bridal shop to have a wedding dress-up day of their own. Mandy’s simple act of generosity elicits moving stories that this documentary compassionately captures.

results.title: Claw & Order
results.overview: When a sudden and unexplained extinction wipes out Whitby’s lobster stocks, the local community is thrown into crisis. Fishermen and scientists must join forces to restore an ecosystem on the brink, with a little help from their hard-shelled heroes.

results.title: The Witches of Pool Bottom
results.overview: When a teenage girl's body-image fears become physical, she decides to destroy them - quite literally.

results.title: Pay As You Go
results.overview: A struggling tenant wants to escape his Pay-As-You-Go Life Tariff, but must first confront a relentlessly cheerful Customer Support officer conducting a routine “Life Utility Check-Up”. A Kafka-esque comedy set in a world where everything is chargeable.

results.title: Practical Anarchy
results.overview: A defiant history of Bradford's 1in12 Club, the member-owned venue that became a beacon for protest and punk subcultures throughout the '80s and '90s. Long-standing club members reflect on the victories, struggles and the evolving destiny of the collective.

results.title: Treading Water
results.overview: Treading Water is a short film directed by Takashi Ogawa, selected for the competitive Asian Students' Film Conference section of the 39th Tokyo International Film Festival, where it will have its world premiere.

results.title: Ubuntu Nation - The Voice of the Voiceless
results.original_title: Nação Ubuntu - A Voz dos Silenciados
results.overview: Created in 1994 with the goal of housing ten thousand people, the Dzaleka camp now has a population of 44,000 refugees. These are people fleeing political, religious, and ethnic conflicts in various countries, mostly the Democratic Republic of Congo. Living in poverty and victims of prejudice, the refugees are not allowed to leave the camp. Faced with this situation of abandonment, four young people came together to bring dignity, work, education, and above all, hope to the people of Dzaleka through the philosophy of Ubuntu.

results.title: Sumpa Kingdom
results.overview: Raised in inland China, the protagonist Yangqing Lamu meets Baima, a young local guide, during an accidental trip to the plateau. The two travel deep into pastoral grasslands, embarking on a spiritual exploration of marriage, life and death, and morality amid the conflicts between dreams and reality, tradition and individuality. In the end, she achieves a profound reconciliation with both her homeland and her inner self in the vast wilderness.

results.title: Rushes of a Killer
results.overview: Footage found in Amsterdam reveals the horrific events that took place behind the scenes of a sinister film project. The recordings show the disturbing creative process of an obsessive filmmaker in pursuit of absolute control.

results.title: Fest Godzilla II: Tokyo Vanishing
results.original_title: フェス・ゴジラⅡ 東京消失
results.overview: As Godzilla unleashes energy powerful enough to engulf and obliterate Tokyo with its heat ray, a new threat, Monster X, emerges. Amidst the fierce clash between these two titans, a Self-Defense Force officer undertakes a perilous, do-or-die mission!

results.title: Dear Marcelle
results.overview: Four queer friends meet at Marcelle's house to get ready for Carnival, but Marcelle no longer wants to see them and leaves them standing on her doorstep without explanation. Shocked and confused, the four friends try to save their friendship from silence.

results.title: c.s: A Melbourne Experience
results.overview: Vast landscapes of a suburb in Melbourne, Australia

results.title: I Think You're Hurting Them
results.overview: Through a series of real and imagined memories, a mourning woman reflects on her life and the person in the mirror that she doesn’t recognize.
